mechanism_claims.claim_text: Recombinant thanatin has source-supported phenotypic antifungal activity against five fungal plant pathogens in MIC/MFC testing.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MIC/MFC and growth-inhibition evidence do not identify a direct molecular target or membrane mechanism in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper verifies recombinant thanatin expression and secretion by SDS-PAGE size comparison, but this is expression identity evidence rather than antimicrobial mechanism evidence.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: recombinant thanatin produced in HEK293 medium
mechanism_claims.limitations: The exact sequence evidence is assigned to Additional file 1, which is not locally available; this claim is not used for source-verified database sequence acceptance.
